about_the_game:
Unleash a new level of stress relief with the Tentacle Touch DLC for BOOBS.

This tantalizing add-on gives you control of soft, flexible tentacles—perfectly designed to enhance your interaction with her gorgeous, physics-driven boobs. Slither, wrap, caress, and play in brand-new ways that offer both playful curiosity and otherworldly satisfaction.

Features:

  • Tentacle Play Unlocked: Swap hands for slick, writhing tentacles that respond fluidly to your every move.

  • New Interactions: Stroke, tease and whip with unprecedented flexibility.

  • Enhanced Controller Support: Control each tentacle individually using both analog sticks for full freedom.

  • Fresh NEW Achievements to unlock: Slither like the best of them to unlock new achievements!

  • Visual & Audio Additions: Subtle squishy sound effects and animations enhance the immersion.

Combine the relaxing core gameplay of BOOBS with a splash of the weird and wild—perfect for players who want something a little more... tentacly.

content_descriptors.notes: There is some nudity in the game. You can undress the character exposing her breasts.
